text:
经验值是这一局的成长：打赢战斗（精英、猎手、首领给得多）、第一次走进更深的一环、在神坛献祭和祷告都会涨；奉了神，做这位神喜欢的事再多给。难度越高，所有途径涨得越快。经验值只涨不花，够了升一级，最高 {level:cap} 级；撤离或阵亡后清零，下一局重来。

每升一级，回到地图时从三张牌里挑一张：属性、武器、探索三类，同一张可以重复拿，拿几张叠几层。局外的科技能给刷新（三张一起换）和删除（这一局不再出）的次数。不奉神就是【以人为本】：逢 {level:every} 的倍数级多选一次。

奉了神，这位神的阶也按这一局的经验值算：过一道门槛升一阶，阶决定信仰道具上写的按阶功能与这位神的等级效果，到了的亮、没到的灰。顶端栏下面那根管子是经验值和等级，停上去看怎么涨。

texts.en:
XP is this run's growth: winning battles (elites, hunters and bosses give more), stepping into a deeper ring for the first time, and offering or praying at Altars all add to it; follow a god and doing what that god likes adds more. Higher difficulties make every source grow faster. XP is never spent; when you have enough you gain a level, up to {level:cap}. It resets when you extract or fall, and the next run starts over.

Each level, pick one of three cards when you're back on the map: Stats, Weapons or Exploration. The same card can be taken again, and each copy stacks. Camp techs grant rerolls (swap all three) and removals (that card won't show again this run). Following no god is Humans First: every {level:every} levels you pick one more.

If you follow a god, that god's Rank also counts this run's XP: pass a threshold to rise a Rank. Rank decides the Rank-based effects written on Faith items and the god's tier effects; those you have reached light up, the rest stay grey. The tube under the top bar shows your XP and level; hover over it to see how to earn more.
